start_here: Say to your AI: "Follow my treg call 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef until its task settles and give me the result link." It runs tool:read-a-treg-call.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads treg's own record of one call by its id and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Keep the x-treg-call-id header that tool:call-a-treg-endpoint answered (32 hex characters).
2. About 60 seconds later, say to your AI: "Read my treg call <id>". It calls tools:run with tool tool:read-a-treg-call, account and call_id.
3. Read async_task.status: pending means read again every 30 to 60 seconds; settled has result_url (it expires, so fetch it at once); released and timed_out charged nothing.
4. Never send the call again or try another provider while it is pending.
